what: `rebase_and_rebump` omits `tmpdir` / rebump bullets path while helpers require `bullets_path`

what: Re-bump "version-regression guard" is one line; bash compares classify output to `${base_remote}/${base_ref}` plugin version and recomputes via `bump_type`
scenario_or_breakage: Stale conflict resolution can yield `NEW_VERSION` below published base; force-push rebases a regressed semver (`scripts/ship-pr.sh` ~3034-3071)
suggested_fix: Spell out parity: read base plugin version from `git show_file` on `{base_remote}/{base_ref}`; if `new_version` < base and bump_type != NONE, recompute with `_apply_bump_type`; then `apply_bump`; cover in `test_rebase.py`
